meta.title: Delete Session
meta.description: Adds a Delete Session row to the sidebar session '...' menu: after confirmation the session is detached from its workspace and its session log and projection cache are permanently removed.

delete.title: Delete this session?
delete.desc: "{title}" will be removed from the workspace and its session log and projection cache will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete.errorActivity: This session still has work in progress. Stop it before deleting.
delete.errorLive: This session is running or still open. Close its tab first.
delete.errorPending: This session still has unmaterialized content. Close its tab or retry shortly.
delete.errorDisk: The session log could not be removed; the registry was left untouched. Retry shortly.
delete.errorNotFound: No session record was found; it may already be deleted.
